tracking_fixture.loss_recovery: After a real adapter frame sample, temporarily delete native gamepads[0] only during synchronous reads; restore its exact property descriptor in finally before the next tick. All 25 first-hand joints unavailable while the second hand stays valid. Next frame recovers original source/joint identities.
tracking_fixture.removal_reacquisition: Toggle real controller slot activation across frames. Retained first-hand joints remain null/NaN after reacquisition; new hand objects recover valid poses/radii; surviving source and joint identities remain stable.
tracking_fixture.mixed_validity: Both bulk methods populate valid entries and NaNs for unavailable entries; false return and individual getPose/getJointPose agreement checked for all joints. Radii remain valid even when a separate base is unavailable.
tracking_fixture.cleanup: Restore native slot descriptors, controller activation and button state; close sessions; remove canvases and realm fixtures. No production testing API added.

resolved_failures.cause: Intentionally invalid WebIDL inputs needed explicit fixture type annotations/casts.
resolved_failures.resolution: Corrected test-only annotations; final strict typecheck and build pass.

resolved_failures.cause: New page was initially opened after the existing runner closed its original browser context for extension relaunch. Regular profile suites had passed.
resolved_failures.resolution: Moved isolated fixture before context shutdown. Final full browser command passed including shared/growable buffers.

specification_reconciliation.new_requirement_corrections: None. No acceptance criterion was relaxed and no Issue edit/comment was made.
specification_reconciliation.original_research_assumption: Chromium exact-length radius-buffer behavior could be used as the contract.
specification_reconciliation.corrected_contract: Accept oversized radius buffers; reject only insufficient capacity, as already reconciled in Issue #29.
specification_reconciliation.rationale: The pinned Hands algorithm, rather than one browser implementation, defines this Issue acceptance.
